- YTXTube runs in its own process: video, the keyboard and the music player no longer share one main thread (all three at once lagged).
- YTXTube: Fast video (on by default, in its settings): the video goes straight to the screen with a SurfaceView, as in the YouTube app, instead of redrawing the app window at every frame.
- YTXTube: only video codecs the phone decodes in hardware are used (AV1 or VP9 decoded in software kept the processor busy); the A/V timing is sampled four times a second instead of at every vsync; the ambient light no longer redraws the whole player at every frame.
- YTXTube: when Pulse's music player starts, YTXTube stops (its place is kept), so the phone's media controls show the music player; swiped away while paused, its notification goes.
- Keyboard: when the screen is turned upside down, the app is told where the visible keyboard really starts (the bar no longer lies over the text box) and the keys keep clear of the camera cut-out.
- Keyboard effects: a free colour with red, green and blue sliders; RGB colour effect behind the whole keyboard. Keyboard settings: each section has its own icon.
